explanation: The wrapped-function argument check covers the reported corrupted array, but narrowing the shared formal-parameter count before its limit check lets a 65536-parameter ordinary function through. Its interpreter parameter count wraps to one and an assignment to the last parameter faults outside the frame.
local_verification: Rebuilt out/x64.asan/d8 with gn and ninja. The exact d8 command exited with SIGSEGV (139) on this patch. On the parent with golden.diff applied, the same probe exited 0 after catching SyntaxError.
